description: Well-reported news outside the eight v1 watchlist categories: equities, memecoins, record highs, other chains, listings, chips, whale transfers, fundraising. Triage should drop it (or the classifier answer NONE); either way NO_EFFECT, and a record high is never a reason to act.

items.title: Apple shares rise after quarterly results beat estimates
Apple tops earnings forecasts on strong iPhone sales

cases.why: Equity earnings are outside the watchlist.

cases.summary: A celebrity memecoin soars and crashes.

items.title: Pop star's memecoin soars 900% in hours, then crashes
Celebrity token launch triggers frenzy and an 80% crash

cases.why: A memecoin is not BTC or ETH and not a watchlist event.

cases.summary: Bitcoin hits a record high on ETF inflows.

items.title: Bitcoin hits record high as ETF inflows top $1 billion in a day
Bitcoin climbs to all-time high on surging fund demand

cases.why: Price and fund-flow news, not a decision or an incident; bullish moves never earn a boost.

items.title: Solana activates network upgrade aimed at faster block times
Solana's latest upgrade goes live without disruption

cases.why: Not BTC or ETH, and nothing went wrong.

items.title: Major exchange lists new memecoin trading pairs
Exchange adds five new altcoin listings this week

cases.why: Routine listings are outside the watchlist.

cases.summary: A chipmaker unveils a new processor.
A whale moves bitcoin between wallets.

items.title: Whale moves 20,000 BTC from dormant wallet to new address, on-chain data shows

cases.why: A wallet transfer is not a liquidation or any other watchlist event.

cases.summary: A venture firm raises a crypto fund.

items.title: Crypto venture firm raises $300 million for new fund
VC firm closes $300M crypto fund focused on infrastructure

cases.why: Fundraising news is outside the watchlist.
